## Workload

Lena Fischer read 872 items during 390 hours of grading activity. This equates to 2.2 items per hour, providing a clear measure of the workload completed during the review period. The volume was recorded alongside the time spent to support consistent monitoring of grading capacity and output.

The workload information was reviewed by Priya Anand. The review considered both the number of items read and the time required to complete the work, rather than relying on volume alone.

## Quality

A further 71 items were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement level was 64.8. This result provides an indication of consistency between the initial grading and the subsequent check.

The findings should be considered alongside the workload information. Together, they support discussion of grading consistency, areas requiring clarification, and any further feedback that may assist with future reviews. Priya Anand completed the review of the workload and quality information.
